market_summary: London session displays clear directional divergence across assets. GBPUSD and XAUUSD show solid bearish setups breaking key support/VAL levels aligned with negative CVD. US100 maintains strong bullish momentum above VWAP/EMA50 trading near session highs. EURUSD and BTCUSD remain range-bound inside value areas with mixed order flow, dictating a neutral HOLD stance.

signals.rationale: Price is inside value area (VAL 4040.95 to VAH 4060.33) and below POC 4047.00. CVD is BEARISH (-1.38) with negative slope (-0.77), agreeing with short momentum. With price failing to reclaim VWAP/POC, edge favors continuation toward session low.

Price is inside value area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11621) and below POC 1.11382. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,490) with positive slope, showing mixed delta context. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains below VWAP (1.11515) and EMA50 (1.11532), pinned near the lower ATR band (1.11329) and session low (1.11307). RVOL is normal (0.96). Given the tight consolidation near session low with conflicting CVD slope inside VA, holding for a clearer breakout or mean-reversion move is prudent.

Price is below VAL (1.33196) and below POC (1.33473), establishing a bearish value area breakdown. CVD is BEARISH (-1,941) with negative slope (-519.53), providing aligned delta pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is cleanly below VWAP (1.33312) and EMA50 (1.33344), probing the lower ATR band (1.33100) and testing Session Low (1.33070). RVOL is elevated at 1.81. Strongly bearish alignment across structural trend, value profile, and CVD supports a short entry.
signals.level_event: breakout below VAL 1.33196 and prev low 1.33119

signals.rationale: Price is inside value area (VAL 28023.92 to VAH 28294.33) but well above POC 28115.86. CVD is BULLISH (+9.20) with positive slope (+0.91), agreeing with the uptrend. CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.04) with flat slope, showing divergence from price. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73669.22) and EMA50 (73729.05), but sits mid-channel after failing to clear S/R 73975.30 and Session High 74085.20. RVOL is weak (0.98, zero spikes). Lack of volume and delta divergence warrant a HOLD.
